resources.string: Scan to rename with your phone

Choose a room or enter a name (up to 48 UTF-8 bytes, about 16 Chinese characters). Used for AirPlay, DLNA and Google Cast. Root-enabled WFD devices also use this name for Wi-Fi Direct (32 UTF-8 bytes maximum; longer names are shortened).
Saved. Reopen the casting list to see the new name.
Enter a nonempty name within 48 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. If saving fails, try again.
Unable to open phone setup. Connect the TV and phone to the same local network and try again.
Connect your phone to the same local network, scan this code and open the page in a browser. This code expires after 10 minutes or when this dialog closes. You can also type the address below.
